-module(robot).
-export([move/2, start/0]).
-record(robot, {pos = {0, 0}, dir = north}).

move(#robot{pos = {X, Y}} = R, [$A | T]) -> move(R#robot{pos = {X, Y + 1}}, T);
move(R, [C | T]) when C =:= $L; C =:= $R -> move(R, T);
move(R, []) -> {ok, R};
move(_, [C | _]) -> {error, C}.

start() ->
    Pid = spawn(fun() -> receive {From, Msg} -> From ! {self(), Msg} after 1000 -> timeout end end),
    Pid ! {self(), <<"hi">>},
    [X * 2 || X <- lists:seq(1, 3), X rem 2 =:= 1].
